data.name: Kuldip
data.gender_notes: Kuldip is used as a male name in Hindu naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: The name Kuldip is derived from the Sanskrit words 'kula' which means 'family' and 'deep' which means 'valor'. This name signifies a brave and strong individual who is deeply rooted in his family values. The name Kuldip carries the meaning “Gold, Sun” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Hindu tradition and is also used in Punjabi, Hindi. Parents who choose Kuldip usually hope their child will grow to embody gold, sun and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: The name Kuldip is a divine name in Hinduism. It is believed that the name is blessed by the gods and brings prosperity, wisdom and strength to the individual.
data.etymology: Kuldip belongs to the Hindu linguistic tradition and is used in Hindu naming. Its recorded meaning is “Gold, Sun.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Kuldip total 1, giving a life-path number of 1. Number 1 is linked with Sun and with the qualities of leadership, independence and initiative.

The epithet of 'deep' in the name suggests a person who fearlessly sits at the forefront of any challenge, while the association with 'family' reaffirms the central importance of family bonds in this ancient culture.
data.spiritual_significance: From a spiritual perspective, the name Kuldip can be seen as a manifestation of the Hindu god Shiva's divine attributes of strength and fearlessness. As Lord Shiva is often depicted as controlling the forces of nature with serene calmness, a person named Kuldip can be seen as embodying the courage and inner peace needed to navigate life's challenges. Moreover, the connection to family values highlights the importance of the strong spiritual bond between individuals and their loved ones.
